# REI Oklahoma Business Lending

> REI Oklahoma provides comprehensive small business lending solutions including SBA 504 loans, USDA programs, and equipment financing across Oklahoma.

REI Oklahoma specializes in connecting small business owners and entrepreneurs with diverse lending programs backed by federal agencies like the SBA and USDA. The organization serves as a resource hub for business financing in Oklahoma, offering guidance on loan programs, lender directories, and payment management.

## Key Topics

- SBA 504 Program
- USDA Intermediary Relending Program
- SBA Microloan
- Equipment Financing
- Small Business Administration (SBA)
- USDA Rural Development
- Commercial Lending
- Direct Loans
- Oklahoma Entrepreneurs
- Manufacturing Equipment Loan Program
- Meat & Poultry Loan Program
- New Markets Tax Credits
- Economic Development Administration
- Business Financing

## Lending Programs & Services

- [What We Can Do For You](https://reibusinesslending.org/home/what-we-can-do-for-you): REI Oklahoma's comprehensive services including SBA, USDA, and equipment financing solutions
- [Business Lending Solutions](https://reibusinesslending.org/businesses): Business lending solutions from REI Oklahoma designed for small business growth and expansion
- [Program Overview](https://reibusinesslending.org/registration-cancelled): Overview of REI Oklahoma's SBA and USDA business lending programs

## Lender Directory

- [Lenders Directory](https://reibusinesslending.org/lenders): Directory of SBA 504 lenders and commercial lending programs available in Oklahoma

## Account & Support Services

- [Contact Information](https://reibusinesslending.org/contact): Contact information for REI Oklahoma business lending inquiries and assistance
- [Make a Payment](https://reibusinesslending.org/make-a-payment): Loan payment portal for REI Oklahoma borrowers to manage their accounts
- [Newsletter Signup](https://reibusinesslending.org/newsletter-sign): Newsletter signup for REI Oklahoma business lending updates and program news
